record.title: Belarus restricts non-exempt foreign land entry under COVID regulation
record.scope: National surface-entry regime; Russia included in reported inward rule
record.crossings: Road; simplified local; rail-station; river-port posts
record.movement: Foreign nationals and stateless people outside exceptions
record.exceptions: Residents, work-authorised travellers, diplomats, freight crews, specified family/humanitarian travel and Russians transiting home; Minsk airport outside ban.
record.imposing_authority: Belarus Council of Ministers and State Border Committee
record.enforcement: See source evidence notes and claim checks for operational confirmation versus policy evidence.
record.consequences: Not separately established beyond the reported crossing obstruction.
record.relationship: Related to EU030 but opposite direction and affected nationality; do not count as two identical full-border closures.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; no status extrapolation to 21 October 2026
record.official_rationale: Officially COVID-19 prevention; introduced during post-election protests, with political motivation alleged by opposition rather than established as official purpose.
record.context: Officially COVID-19 prevention; introduced during post-election protests, with political motivation alleged by opposition rather than established as official purpose.
record.uncertainty: 29 October abrupt restrictions were a prior phase not dated as this nationwide rule. April repeal confirmed retrospectively with increased arrivals during following week, not an independently observed exact first opening at each post. Exemptions changed over time.

historical.duration_note: Formal change of permission; operational reopening and continuous effective duration not established
